thread.title: Oclaro, Optical Device Makers Rebound On Hopes Bottom Is Near

author: REINHARDT KRAUSE
title: Oclaro, Optical Device Makers Rebound On Hopes Bottom Is Near
text:
Shares in optical device makers popped Tuesday on views that Oclaro 's ( OCLR ) March and June quarter outlook could have signaled that the sector's downturn may bottom out in early 2018.
X Oclaro jumped nearly 21% to 6.83 on the stock market today . Finisar ( FNSR ) climbed 7.9% to 18.03; Acacia Communications ( ACIA ) rose 2.9% to 39.57; and NeoPhotonics ( NPTN ) gained 12.8% to 5.82. Infinera ( INFN ) rose 9.3% to 6.83.
Oclaro late Monday reported fiscal second-quarter revenue and earnings per share that were slightly above consensus, while March-quarter guidance was below expectations. However, management commentary indicated that China and the data center market may bounce back following the March quarter, analysts said.
"We believe management had a much more upbeat tone compared with the last several quarters and called the bottom on fiscal third quarter (March)," Dmitry Netis, a William Blair analyst, said in a report. "The company expects sequential revenue growth in the remaining three quarters of calendar 2018."
Lumentum Holdings ( LITE ), Oclaro, Finisar and other makers of optical components have been slammed by a slowdown in telecom-related orders in China and technology shifts in the data center market. Lumentum surged Tuesday after it said second-half 2018 shipments of 3D sensors will jump from a year earlier. Its biggest customer for 3D sensors is Apple ( AAPL ).
